ground_truth.task: fix a pipeline that leaks build artifacts across concurrent runs

possible_mistakes: Serialize the pipeline to hide the isolation bug.
Share a cache key across branches.
hints: Concurrent flakiness often means shared state.
Scope caches by branch/commit, workspaces per run.
alternative_solution: Use ephemeral runners/containers so no state survives a run.
edge_cases: A shared toolchain install races between two runs upgrading it.
